# dsh-model-price — API pricing for DeepSeek Harness **English** | [Русский](README.ru.md) | [Website](https://itsbuyru-bit.github.io/dsh-model-price/) [![CI](https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform: Web / Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20%2F%20Desktop-0078D4.svg)](#requirements) [![DeepSeek Harness: 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.x-6f42c1.svg)](#supported-versions) [![Languages: 9](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-9-2ea44f.svg)](#languages) Per-model API prices, wallet balance and live session spend for **DeepSeek Harness**. The plugin adds a compact line under the chat composer — `Session: $0.0123 · Wallet: $12.34 · Peak` — and a **Models & prices** section in Settings where you enter what each model costs per million tokens, in USD or CNY, separately for Peak and Off-Peak hours. The plugin is a Host + Client bundle. It does not patch Harness, does not modify session logs, and keeps all of its data in `~/.dsh/api-spend/`. > **Unofficial.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored > by DeepSeek. “DeepSeek” and “DeepSeek Harness” belong to their respective > authors. See [Non-affiliation](#non-affiliation). --- ## Screenshots

| Settings — Display | Settings — Models | |:---:|:---:| | | | --- ## Table of contents - [Screenshots](#screenshots) - [What this plugin does](#what-this-plugin-does) - [Features](#features) - [Supported versions](#supported-versions) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Price model](#price-model) - [Languages](#languages) - [Data and privacy](#data-and-privacy) - [Project structure](#project-structure) - [Testing](#testing) - [Updating](#updating) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Limitations](#limitations) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [Security](#security) - [License and credits](#license-and-credits) - [Non-affiliation](#non-affiliation) --- ## What this plugin does DeepSeek Harness reports token usage per step but has no per-model price table and no wallet display. This plugin adds both: | Surface | What it shows | Where it lives | |---|---|---| | Composer line | Session spend, wallet balance, Peak / Off-Peak badge, live indicator | `conversation.composer.dock`, order 2 | | Popover | Token composition, per-model cost, wallet split, child sessions, all-time total | Click the line | | Settings section | Price table per model, currency, manual FX rate, Off-Peak window, language | `settings.section`, order 30 | | Host API | Prices, wallet and session aggregation | `/api-spend/api/*` | The plugin works from the durable session log: it folds `assistant/message` usage into a session projection and prices it on read. It does not estimate tokens, does not rewrite logs, and does not block requests. --- ## Features - **Per-model price table** — input (cache miss), output, cache hit and cache write, each with a Peak and an Off-Peak rate. - **Two currencies** — enter prices in USD or CNY, display in one currency and convert with a manual rate stored in the settings. - **Wallet** — real DeepSeek account balance plus bonus wallets; a local budget can stand in when the account is unavailable. - **Live session cost** — updates while the model works; retries are de-duplicated and aborted steps without usage are reported, not guessed. - **Peak / Off-Peak** — editable UTC window, orange Peak badge, green Off-Peak badge, and the matching price column is used for each settlement. - **Model sync** — one click mirrors the models bound in **Settings → Models**. Providers with an empty model list contribute nothing, and models removed from that list disappear from the price table with their prices. - **Localized** — 9 bundled languages with automatic discovery of new locale files. - **Best time** — the popover shows the current or next Off-Peak block in local time and a countdown until it starts (or until it ends, when already active). - **Search & Fetch costs** — successful `web_search` / `web_fetch` calls are counted and shown separately; they are free until 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC and billed at $0.75 per 1,000 requests afterwards. - **Update indicator** — optional check of the latest GitHub release (at most once every 6 hours), a **Check now** button and a link to the newer release in the About block. - **Dependency-free, build-free** — plain JavaScript, no runtime packages. --- ## Supported versions | Component | Value | |---|---| | DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.x** — tested on **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop, Windows) | | Profile | `desktop` (Web/Desktop); any profile that mounts the Web UI | | Node.js | bundled with DSH, **22.5+** | | Plugin version | **1.9.0** | The plugin is not gated on an exact Harness version. If a future release renames a slot, a projection key or a service, the affected part degrades to “no line”/“no wallet” instead of crashing the page; the Host API keeps working. --- ## Requirements | Need | Why | |---|---| | **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** | Provides the Web UI, session projections and the account service | | **A Web/Desktop profile** | The composer line and the settings section are Web-UI slots | | **DeepSeek account (optional)** | Only for the wallet balance; without it use the local-budget fallback | | **No build tools** | The bundle ships `index.js` and `client.js` as-is | Works on Windows, macOS and Linux; the UI uses Harness theme tokens and follows the active theme automatically. --- ## Quick start ### Option 1 — Add Plugin (recommended) 1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**. 2. Paste one of: ``` github:itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` ``` https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` ``` /path/to/dsh-model-price ``` 3. Install, restart DeepSeek Harness and refresh the page. The plugin is distributed from GitHub; there is no npm registry package. ### Option 2 — CLI ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price ``` The `desktop` profile is owned by the Electron application and the CLI refuses to write to it; use **Add Plugin** in the UI for that profile. ### Option 3 — local development ```sh git clone https://github.com/itsbuyru-bit/dsh-model-price.git dsh plugin --profile add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-model-price ``` Host changes require reinstalling the bundle; client changes only need a page refresh. --- ## Usage 1. Open **Settings → Models & prices**. 2. In **Discounts & time** set the shared Peak windows, Peak days, holiday days and the Search & Fetch billing. The block sits right under **Display** and applies to every model that has no schedule of its own. 3. Press **Load models from Models** to import the models configured in the harness, or add one manually by provider and model id. 4. Expand a model row and fill the Peak / Off-Peak prices per 1M tokens. The same card records where the numbers came from: open **Source and check date**, paste the pricing-page URL and the check date, and the collapsed row keeps showing the domain, `Checked YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)` and an **Open** button. 5. Optional: tick **Own Peak schedule for this model** in a model card and give that m

plugins.description: Skills page for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: inspect, download, upload and edit SKILL.md files
plugins.readme_text:
# @dr-co/dsh-skills

A **Skills page** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI: a sidebar row that opens a full main panel listing every skill the host knows about — our own, the ones bundled inside installed packages, and the ones a plugin provides without any file — with download, upload, rename, enable/disable, and editing built in.

The page reads the filesystem itself instead of asking `ctx.skills` alone, because that service only reports the skills it can load. A skill whose file is named `_SKILL.md` is invisible to the core on purpose — and it is exactly the one you need to see when a skill stops working.

## What it does

The list is three sections, each with its own heading, count, and empty state:

| Section | Where it comes from | Colours | Actions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Standard skills in `$DSH_HOME/skills`** | our own directories | green dot when active, grey when disabled, normal name colour | everything: view, edit, rename, upload, both downloads, enable/disable |
| **Skills bundled with plugins** | `<pkg>/skills/*` and `<pkg>/assets/*` of every installed package, found through their manifests | pink dot and pink name when active, grey-pink when disabled | view and both downloads — they live in `node_modules` |
| **Provided by plugins (no file)** | `ctx.skills.list()` entries with no file on disk | pink, dashed dot | view and `Download SKILL.md`; no ZIP, because there is no directory to archive |

- **Status** is one 11px dot: green for `SKILL.md`, grey for `_SKILL.md` (ours); pink for an active packaged skill, grey-pink for a disabled one. A directory holding both files is reported as a conflict, in red. The word lives in the dot's tooltip and accessible name, not in the row.
- **Name** takes every pixel the row has left, with the frontmatter `description` underneath; both are cut with an ellipsis, never wrapped.
- **Path** is relative to `$DSH_HOME` when it is inside it, otherwise relative to the package; shown in full up to 15 characters and, past that, as its first 7 and last 7 around three dots (`split/p...ath/foo`). The full path is in the tooltip. Below 640px the column is not rendered at all and the row keeps the path in its accessible name.
- **View** — the first item in every row's menu, for all three sections. It opens the same full-page frame as the editor but read-only: the raw text, no `textarea`, no `Save`, a `Read-only` badge, `Close` back to the list, and `Edit` beside it when the skill may be edited. Nothing is rendered — no markdown, no highlighting — and nothing can be written from it. A provider skill's text comes from `ctx.skills.get(name)`; if it returns an empty body the page says *content is not available for this skill* rather than showing a blank screen.
- **Row menu** — `View`, `Edit`, `Rename`, `Download SKILL.md`, `Download ZIP`, `Upload`, `Enable`/`Disable`, in that order, separated into groups. On a wide screen the first action is also reachable from the split button: a pencil that opens the editor plus a chevron for the menu. On a narrow one there is a single `⋯` and Edit is the first item.
- **Edit** — a full-page view inside the panel (not a dialog, not a URL): one plain monospace `textarea` filling the panel, `Cancel` and `Save` at the bottom. There is no preview at any width. `Save` stays disabled until something changes; a file that changed on disk after it was opened raises a warning before the first save, and the second press overwrites.
- **Rename** — renames the skill's *directory* (never the frontmatter `name`), inline, with the current name prefilled, kebab-case validation, and an atomic `rename()` inside the same parent. A name that is already taken is refused, and a failure leaves the original directory untouched.
- **Enable / Disable** — the harness' own switch: `SKILL.md` → `_SKILL.md` and back. After the rename the row updates in place (dot, path, menu) and a notice says exactly what happened on disk: `File SKILL.md renamed to _SKILL.md`.
- **Download SKILL.md** — the exact file bytes, `Content-Disposition: attachment`.
- **Download ZIP** — the whole skill directory rooted at its own name, attachments (`bin/`, `data/`, anything else) included, so the archive can be uploaded back as-is.
- **English and Russian** — the whole page, notices and error messages included. Russian is a complete dictionary registered with `ctx.locale.addLanguage({ id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', fallback: 'en' })`; nothing falls back to English mid-sentence.

### Colours and themes

Green and grey are the shell's own tokens (`--dsw-alias-state-success-primary` for on, `--dsw-alias-state-idle-primary` for off), so they match the rest of the interface in every theme for free. Pink is not in the token set, so the plugin defines two variables of its own and gives both palettes their own values:

| Palette | `--dshsk-plugin-accent` | contrast on the panel | `--dshsk-plugin-accent-muted` | contrast |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| light (`#ffffff`) | `#c2185b` | 5.87:1 | `#8d5f72` | 5.23:1 |
| dark (`#232324`) | `#f472b6` | 5.93:1 | `#c98ba6` | 5.78:1 |

Both clear the 4.5:1 bar for text and the 3:1 bar for the dot, and both are above the shell's green on white (2.28:1). The dark block keys off `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` — the attribute the shell's own theme presenter writes when it applies a snapshot — and *not* off `prefers-color-scheme`, because the resolved scheme follows the user's setting (including "system" dark and registered themes), not the operating system. The test recomputes both ratios from the values in `src/client/styles.js`.

### Two uploads, two contracts

The page button and the row menu are not the same operation, and the difference is deliberate: a stray drop should not be able to overwrite a working skill.

| Upload | Accepted | Name comes from | If the name is taken |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Page button (create)** | only a ZIP with one top-level folder containing `SKILL.md` | the folder name (kebab-case) | refused: *a skill with this name already exists* — replace it from the row menu instead |
| **Row menu (replace)** | a single `SKILL.md`, or a ZIP whose folder is this skill's own name | the row | — (this is the only way to replace) |

A new skill is created from a zip whose top-level folder is the skill name; a single `SKILL.md` is only accepted when replacing an existing skill. Everything else — several top-level entries, `SKILL.md` at the archive root, an archive without `SKILL.md`, an illegal folder name, a broken archive, a non-ZIP file for the create upload, a file not named `SKILL.md` for the replace upload — is refused with `Unrecognized skill format` («Нераспознаваемый формат скилла») and nothing on disk changes.

Safety, in the order it happens: every path is resolved and proved to stay inside its root (traversal segments, absolute paths, drive letters and leading dots are refused before the filesystem sees them); a skill directory and its file must be real — a symlinked `SKILL.md` is skipped by the list and never read, written, or archived; a packaged skill is refused by the *host* for every write (`403 read-only`), not merely hidden by the browser; uploads are capped; a ZIP is unpacked into a dot-prefixed staging directory and swapped in by rename only after every member has validated, with the previous directory restored if the swap fails; file modes from the archive are preserved. A refused upload leaves the tree byte-identical, which is what the tests assert.

## Install

The package ships a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `dsh plugin add` both installs it and mounts it; it then appears in the settings plugin list where it can be switched off or removed.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @dr-co/dsh-skills
```

From a checkout, while developing:

```sh
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:$PWD
```

Restart the Web GUI afterwards. The sidebar gains a **Skills** row after Plugins and Tasks.

### Configuration

```yaml
- id: dsh-skills
  name: '@dr-co/dsh-skills'
  config:
    dshHome: /home/dsh/work/ai/.dsh   # default: $DSH_HOME, then ~/.dsh
    dshInstall: /opt/dsh              # de

plugins.description: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel templates, Python charts, code cards and a Presentations mode.
plugins.readme_text:
# PowerPoint Builder for DeepSeek Harness

A plugin bundle that lets an agent build real Microsoft PowerPoint decks: pastel
palettes, nine reusable slide templates with exact geometric centering, styled
text boxes, internet images, charts rendered by Python, and highlighted code
cards. It also ships a **Presentations** agent mode tuned for deck work.

The `.pptx` package (ZIP + OOXML) is written by the plugin itself, so there is
no Office dependency, no network round-trip after an image is embedded, and the
file stays valid after every call.

## Install

Install the bundle into the current profile:

```text
plugin_manager { "action": "install_bundle", "target": "dsh-pptx-builder" }
```

Or use **Plugins → Install** in the Harness UI and paste the package name.
After a restart the tools show up in every mode, and a new **Presentations**
agent preset appears in the mode picker for a new session.

From a local checkout, pass the absolute directory instead of the package name.

## Presentations mode

The preset adds a persona that knows the workflow — inspect before editing,
build from templates, cite data sources, finish with `present` — plus a focused
toolset: the `pptx_*` tools, file reading, web search/fetch, `present`,
`todo_write`, `ask_user_question`, and compaction. The tools themselves are
registered host-wide, so they are also usable outside this mode.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `pptx_create` | Creates a deck on a pastel palette: size (`16:9` / `4:3`), palette, default font, accent, page-number placement. |
| `pptx_gallery` | Builds a ready-made reference deck: `features` tours every template, alignment, list style and chart kind; `showcase` is a polished business deck. |
| `pptx_add_slide` | Adds a slide from a template (`title`, `section`, `content`, `split-left`, `split-right`, `chart`, `code`, `closing`, `blank`) with a heading, text, presenter and photo. |
| `pptx_add_text` | Arbitrary text box: `role`, `x`/`y`/`w`/`h`, `font_size`/`font_face`/`bold`/`italic`/`underline`/`color`/`align`/`valign`/`bullet`. |
| `pptx_add_image` | Downloads an image by `url` (or reads a local `path`), embeds the bytes and places it; the aspect ratio is preserved. |
| `pptx_add_chart` | Renders a chart from data (bar, stacked bar, line, area, pie, donut) with Python and embeds it. |
| `pptx_add_code` | Renders a code snippet as a dark card with syntax highlighting, line numbers, a file-name header and highlighted lines. |
| `pptx_update_element` | Moves, resizes, restyles, retypes or replaces an existing element by id. |
| `pptx_remove` | Deletes one element by id, or a whole slide by its 1-based number. |
| `pptx_inspect` | Lists the template, palette and every element with ids, geometry in inches, text, fonts and sources. |

Coordinates are inches from the top-left corner of the slide (16:9 is
13.333 × 7.5), font sizes are points, colours are `#RRGGBB`, a basic colour
name, or a palette keyword (`ink`, `muted`, `accent`, `background`).

## Templates

| Template | Layout |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Oversized centred heading, subtitle below, presenter line in the bottom-right corner. Page number off. |
| `section` | Divider: heading and subtitle centred on the slide. |
| `content` | Centred heading on top, a fixed-width text column underneath. |
| `split-right` | Photo fitted and centred in the right half; heading and text centred in the left half. |
| `split-left` | Mirrored: photo on the left, text on the right. |
| `chart` | Heading and caption on top, the lower two thirds reserved for `pptx_add_chart`. |
| `code` | Heading and subtitle on top, the rest reserved for `pptx_add_code`. |
| `closing` | Large centred "Спасибо за внимание" (override with `title`), optional subtitle. |
| `blank` | Nothing but the background. |

Every template centres its content inside its own region: the photo in its half,
the heading and text in theirs, blocks centered vertically.

## Palettes

`pptx_create` takes `palette`: `sand` (default), `mint`, `lavender`, `sky`,
`rose`. A palette defines the pastel background of every slide, the body ink,
the muted secondary colour, the accent, and the chart series colours.

## Alignment and lists

Alignment and text shape are parameters, not template defaults:

| Parameter | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `align` | `left`, `center`, `right`, `justify` for the `text` block |
| `title_align` | the same for the heading and subtitle |
| `bullet` | `true` for a bulleted list, `false` (default) for one solid block |

Defaults: `content` is left-aligned, `split-left` / `split-right` are centred
without bullets and left-aligned with them. Long lists read best on the left;
centred or right-aligned text suits short lines and single paragraphs. An
existing block can be re-aligned with `pptx_update_element` (`align`, `bullet`).

## Charts

`pptx_add_chart` accepts data, not code:

```json
{ "file": "sales.pptx", "kind": "bar", "stacked": false,
  "categories": ["2021", "2022", "2023", "2024"],
  "series": [ { "name": "Revenue", "values": [10.2, 13.8, 17.1, 21.4] } ],
  "y_label": "bn RUB", "value_format": "auto",
  "source": "Source: annual reports, 2025" }
```

Supported: `bar` (including `stacked`), `line`, `area`, `pie`, `donut`. The
renderer draws the palette background, a light grid, axis labels, a legend,
value labels and a source footnote. The image is 1800 × 1000 px and is embedded
into the deck.

Data pipeline: `web_search` / `web_fetch` find the numbers, the model puts them
into `categories` and `series`, `pptx_add_chart` draws the picture, and
`pptx_update_element` can move or resize it.

## Code cards

`pptx_add_code` renders a snippet into a dark rounded card — syntax
highlighting, line numbers, a file-name header, a language chip, and an accent
band on highlighted lines — and embeds it as a picture.

```text
pptx_add_slide { "file": "d.pptx", "template": "code",
                 "title": "How we measure", "subtitle": "python · pandas" }
pptx_add_code  { "file": "d.pptx", "language": "python", "title": "metrics.py",
                 "highlight_lines": [5, 6], "code": "import pandas as pd\n..." }
```

Languages: `python`, `javascript`, `typescript`, `json`, `bash`, `sql`, `text`.
Keep lines under ~90 characters and the snippet under 60 lines: the card scales
as a whole, so one long line shrinks all the code. The card is a picture — to
change the code, remove the element and add it again.

## Examples

`pptx_gallery` builds reference decks from code, so they always match the
current templates:

| `style` | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `features` | A tour: all nine templates, three alignments, list and solid text, both split slides, four chart kinds, two code cards, palettes and settings. |
| `showcase` | A polished ten-slide business deck: title, context, charts, photo slides, a metrics code card, closing. |

```text
pptx_gallery { "file": "examples/features.pptx", "style": "features", "palette": "sand" }
pptx_gallery { "file": "examples/showcase.pptx", "style": "showcase", "palette": "mint" }
```

Both decks are ordinary editable decks: inspect them, reuse their geometry, or
continue from them.

## Deck state

A `.pptx` cannot be edited incrementally without a model, so the plugin keeps
the deck document in `<name>.pptx.json` beside the presentation and rebuilds the
package from it on every change. The sidecar is the editable source; the `.pptx`
is always a valid output. Deleting the sidecar does not break the presentation,
but makes it not editable by the plugin.

## Configuration

Optional `config` fields on the `pptx-builder` Loader row:

| Field | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `font` | `Calibri` | Default text font. |
| `accent` | from the palette | Accent colour overriding the palette. |
| `maxImageBytes` | `20971520` | Size limit for a downloaded image (20 MB). |
| `pythonPath` | auto-detected | Python interpreter with Pillow for charts and code cards. |

## Requirements

- Charts and code cards are rendered by Python with Pillow. Harness ships such
  a runtime, and the plugin finds it automatically; on another setup point
  `pythonPath` at an interpreter where `import PIL` works.
- Images

plugins.description: dsh-Hestia Memory Runtime — cognitive memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (HMR): reasoning chains, reflection, self-evolution. Monorepo: dsh-hmr + @dsh-hmr/hmr-client
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-hmr — dsh-Hestia Memory Runtime

**全名：dsh-Hestia Memory Runtime**（包名 `dsh-hmr`，工具前缀 `hmr_`，可简称 HMR 认知记忆）。

把 [HMR](https://github.com/snowfoxHQ/HMR) 认知记忆运行时接入 **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** 的 monorepo。

HMR 提供的不只是"存笔记 + 搜笔记"，而是显式推理链、反思循环、主动遗忘曲线和自我演化。
`dsh-hmr` 把这些能力包装成 dsh 插件，让 harness 里的 agent 拥有跨会话的认知上下文。

> 名称说明：官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` 是**热更新（hot module replacement）**，与
> **dsh-Hestia Memory Runtime** 同名不同物，二者无代码关联。

## 目录结构

monorepo 按「可发布的 dsh 插件」「dsh skill」「共享库」三类分目录：

```
dsh-hmr/
├── docs/
│   └── dsh-listing.md     # 提交给 dsh 插件目录的条目文案（显示名：dsh-Hestia Memory Runtime）
├── packages/
│   └── hmr-client/        # 共享 TS 库，封装 HMR 的 HTTP 接口（独立 npm 包）
├── plugins/
│   └── dsh-hmr/           # dsh 插件本体，注册 hmr_* 工具（独立 npm 包）
├── skills/                # dsh skill 目录（当前为空，见 skills/README.md）
├── patches/               # 插件依赖但上游未合并的服务端修复，构建时打到副本上
└── vendor/
    └── hmr/               # HMR 上游仓库（git submodule，保持 origin 原样）
        ├── hmr/           # Python 认知运行时
        └── service/       # FastAPI HTTP 服务（127.0.0.1:8077）
```

新增内容时的归属：dsh 插件放 `plugins/<name>/`，dsh skill 放 `skills/<name>/`，被多个包复用的
库放 `packages/<name>/`；三者都是 npm workspace，都会随 `npm run build/test` 一起跑。

`vendor/hmr` **保持上游纯净**：子仓永远停在 `origin/main` 的某个提交上，不改文件、不打本地提交。
插件确实需要的上游修复放在 `patches/*.patch`，由 `scripts/vendor-python.mjs` 在复制到
`plugins/dsh-hmr/python/` 之后应用到**副本**上（见 `patches/README.md`）。
这样 `git -C vendor/hmr status` 恒为干净，发布物里又包含修复。

## 架构

```
dsh agent
   │  hmr_* 工具
   ▼
plugins/dsh-hmr         (Node.js 插件)
   │  HTTP + x-hmr-token
   ▼
vendor/hmr/service      (Python · FastAPI · 127.0.0.1:8077)
   │
   ▼
vendor/hmr/hmr          (认知运行时：SQLite + 向量索引 + 推理链)
```

插件默认以 **managed 模式**拉起 Python 子进程；把 `dsh-hmr.process` 设为 `external`
则退化为连接已有服务（适合已经常驻跑着 HMR 的场景）。

## 快速开始

> **只想用插件、不想改代码？** 不用 clone 本仓库：先装宿主程序
> [dsh](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)（`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`），
> 再 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hmr`。完整步骤见
> [`plugins/dsh-hmr/README.md`](plugins/dsh-hmr/README.md)。
> 下面是从源码构建的开发者流程。

```bash
# 1. 拉取 HMR 子模块
git submodule update --init --recursive

# 2. 安装 Python 依赖（插件通过 PYTHONPATH 直接加载 vendor 源码，无需 pip install -e）
pip install pydantic numpy fastapi uvicorn
pip install sentence-transformers   # 可选，缺失时退化为 TF-IDF

# 3. 安装 Node 依赖并构建
npm install
npm run build

# 4. 自检 Python 环境与内置运行时
node plugins/dsh-hmr/dist/cli.js doctor

# 5. 在 dsh 中启用插件
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/dsh-hmr
```

## 环境变量

插件会把下列变量透传给 HMR 子进程；embedding 后端完全由你在这里决定：

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `HMR_STORAGE_PATH` | `~/.dsh-hmr/data` | 记忆数据目录；盘符不存在时插件会忽略并回退到默认值 |
| `HMR_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址，不要改成 `0.0.0.0` |
| `HMR_PORT` | `8077` | 服务端口 |
| `HMR_TOKEN` | 空 | 设置后客户端必须带同名 `x-hmr-token` |
| `HMR_ST_MODEL` | `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` | 本地 embedding 模型 |
| `HMR_OLLAMA_MODEL` | 空 | 走 Ollama embedding 时指定模型 |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | 空 | 优先级最高的 embedding 来源 |

优先级：`OPENAI_API_KEY` > `HMR_OLLAMA_MODEL` > `HMR_ST_MODEL` > TF-IDF 兜底。

## 工具（暴露给 agent）

| 工具 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `hmr_ingest` | 写入记忆，可交给 Policy 自动判定类型 |
| `hmr_recall` | 主动召回，支持 Policy 选策略 |
| `hmr_think` | 起一条思考链并记录推理步骤 |
| `hmr_reflect` | 对思考链做反思，产出洞察与建议记忆 |
| `hmr_evolve` | 运行自我演化周期（支持 dry-run 预览） |

## 安全

- 服务只绑 `127.0.0.1`，不要对外开放。
- 不要把抓取来的不可信网页内容直接写进长期记忆（memory poisoning）。
- `HMR_TOKEN` 建议在多人共用的机器上设置。

## 开发

```bash
git clone --recursive https://github.com/snowfoxHQ/dsh-hmr.git   # vendor/hmr 是子模块
npm install
npm run build      # 两个包全量构建（插件会先把 vendor/hmr 复制进 python/ 并打 patch）
npm run typecheck
npm test           # 两个包的集成测试，会真实拉起 Python 服务
```

已 clone 但没带 `--recursive` 时补一步：`git submodule update --init --recursive`。

全链路回归（用真实 agent 跑一遍 `hmr_*` 工具）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add ./plugins/dsh-hmr
dsh --profile headless "用 hmr_ingest 记录一条记忆，再用 hmr_recall 查回来"
```

`vendor/hmr` 是只读上游子模块，**不要在子仓里做任何提交**。确实需要的服务端修复写成
`patches/*.patch`，由 `vendor:python` 在复制副本时应用（详见 `patches/README.md`）。

### 发布

```bash
npm run preflight     # npm pack 预检：元数据、tarball 清单、解包后 import 冒烟
npm run release:dry   # 干净工作树 + 构建 + 预检 + npm publish --dry-run
npm run release       # 真正发布（默认 latest；可加 -- --tag next --otp 123456）
```

`release` 按 `@dsh-hmr/hmr-client` → `dsh-hmr` 的顺序发布，两个包共用同一个版本号，版本不一致
会直接拒绝。发布前会检查该版本是否已存在于 npm，发布后会回查 `npm view` 确认。

如果本机 npm 指向镜像（`npmmirror` / `taobao` 等），脚本会拒绝发布并提示改用官方源：

```bash
npm run release -- --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
```

首次发布前还需要在 npm 上创建 `@dsh-hmr` scope，并让 registry 指向官方源（镜像只读）。完整的
一次性准备、key/2FA 说明、验证命令与错误排查见 **[RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md)**。

## License

MIT，与上游 HMR 一致。

plugins.description: Post-edit impact checks for DeepSeek Harness agents — a symbol index and reference graph that tell you what an edit touched, without re-scanning the repo.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-code-impact

**Post-edit impact checks for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) — a symbol index, a reference graph, and an inheritance model that answer "what did this edit touch?" instead of "grep the repo and re-run everything".**

[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4B6BFB?style=flat-square)](package.json)
[![engine](https://img.shields.io/badge/engine-heuristic%20·%20zero%20deps-3DA639?style=flat-square)](#how-it-works)
[![languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-TS%20·%20JS%20·%20Go-3178C6?style=flat-square)](#scope--limits)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-36%20passing-3DA639?style=flat-square)](test/selftest.mjs)

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

---

## Why

Every small edit — a default value, a rename, a deleted method — triggers the same ceremony:
search the whole repo, open a pile of files, run the full type-check and the full test suite.
The problem isn't wanting full coverage. The problem is doing it by **scanning**.

An index inverts that:

- the whole repo's relationships are already in memory, so a "full check" is one **query**, not a scan;
- after an edit, only the **changed file** is re-parsed, and the reference edges tell you exactly which sites must be revisited;
- answers never say "probably fine" — they give `file:line`, a confidence, and an explicitly listed **unverified** part.

## What you get

Two tools, registered into every agent session — plus a browsable page of the same index
(**Settings → Code Impact**).

### `code_query`

| `op` | Answers |
| --- | --- |
| `find` | where is this symbol (`addNode`, `Graph.addNode`, `ts:src/x.ts#Graph.addNode`) |
| `outline` | declaration skeleton of one file, with line ranges, exports, heritage clauses |
| `refs` | who mentions this symbol — each site resolved individually, so a same-named local doesn't count |
| `hierarchy` | extends / implements / subtypes / members (own, inherited, overridden) |
| `search` | substring match over names and signatures |
| `status` | index size, root, cache location, engine mode, parse failures |

```
find "parseTimeout" — 1 match

ts:src/config.ts#parseTimeout
  variable  src/config.ts:1-1  exported  refs:3
  parseTimeout = 30 ;
```

```
refs ts:src/config.ts#parseTimeout — 3 sites (exported, refs:3)
  variable src/config.ts:1  parseTimeout = 30 ;
  confidence: exact 3 · resolved 0 · heuristic 0 · unresolved mentions 0

src/policy.ts:4  value  in RetryPolicy
    timeout = parseTimeout;
src/service.ts:5  value  in makeService
    const policy = buildPolicy({ timeout: parseTimeout });
```

### `code_verify`

Call it after editing instead of re-scanning. It re-parses only the files that changed on disk
(and discovers new ones), then reports a symbol-level diff:

```
verify — verdict: internal
  1 file changed (0 deleted) · +0 -0 symbols · 1 body-only

body-only (signature unchanged, callers unaffected):
  ts:src/config.ts#parseTimeout  refs:6
```

```
verify — verdict: breaking
  1 file changed (0 deleted) · +1 -1 symbols · 1 contract

symbols that no longer exist:
  ts:src/config.ts#parseTimeout

references that no longer resolve:
  dangling src/policy.ts:4  parseTimeout
```

`verdict` has four levels: `clean` (nothing changed), `internal` (implementation only),
`contract` (signature/export changed, callers may need edits), `breaking` (some reference no
longer resolves).

A reference is only called dangling when it **used to resolve to the symbol that went away**. A
mention that never resolved in the first place — `filepath.Base`, a package that is not installed,
a name the heuristic merely guessed at — is not reported, because a false alarm costs more than a
missed one.

The rule that makes it useful in practice: `const timeout = 30` → `= 60` is a **value change**,
reported as body-only, never as a contract change. Containers (class / interface / struct) are not
listed themselves — their members already express the change, so one memo edit doesn't drag the
whole class into the report.

`code_verify` is **incremental**: it reports changes since the index last synced. Ask twice without
editing in between and the second answer is `clean`. That's the intended loop — one question after
each edit, and the answer is about what you just did.

## The index page

The same index is browsable: **Settings → Code Impact**. Three views over the workspace, drawn from
the index rather than from a fresh scan:

| view | what it answers |
| --- | --- |
| Architecture | a treemap of directories weighted by symbol count, coloured by language — where the code actually lives |
| Imports | the file-level import graph as a chord diagram; hover a file to isolate its edges |
| Inheritance | the type hierarchy by depth, `implements` drawn dashed |
| Sessions | which sessions used the plugin, what they asked, what came back |

Clicking a file lists its symbols with kind, signature and line; clicking a type shows its
supertypes, subtypes and the file that declares it. The header carries the honesty chips —
files / symbols / names / languages, when the index was built, and a warning when files were
skipped — plus a `Refresh` button that re-checks the disk before redrawing.

The **Sessions** tab is the plugin's own audit trail: every `code_query` / `code_verify` call is
recorded per session (id, working directory, call counts, and the last 40 calls with their target
and one-line outcome). It is written to `$DSH_HOME/cache/code-index/usage.json`, so it survives a
restart and covers sessions this process never saw. It records the plugin's own calls only — it is
not an authority on what the agent did — and `Clear` empties it without touching the index.

`Open full page` puts the same map in a browser tab (`/code-impact/app`) with more room and no
settings chrome behind it; the two views share the same routes and the same index.

The page draws **one indexed workspace at a time**, and the folder box under the header is how a
second one gets in: type an absolute path (`D:\work\my-project`), press Enter, and the page builds
an index for it and switches to it. The same workspace stays in the dropdown afterwards. This is
the only way a workspace appears without the agent using a tool in it first — a session whose cwd
is the project also indexes it, implicitly, the first time `code_query` runs.

It is a client half of the bundle (`client.js`, React, theme tokens only — no iframe, no inline
HTML), talking to the host through read routes, one build route, and the usage routes. The
standalone page (`web/app.html` + `web/app.js`, plain DOM and SVG) is served from the same host:

```
GET  /code-impact/api/roots
GET  /code-impact/api/overview?root=<abs path>&refresh=1
GET  /code-impact/api/file?root=<abs path>&path=<repo-relative path>
POST /code-impact/api/index          {"root": "<absolute path>"}
GET  /code-impact/api/usage?limit=100
POST /code-impact/api/usage/clear    {}
GET  /code-impact/app                the full-page view
GET  /code-impact/app.js
```

Reads are allow-listed: the page can only read a directory that is already indexed, or the
session's working directory. `POST /index` is the one route that does work on request — it builds a
cache for the exact directory you named and nothing else, refuses relative paths, missing
directories and plain files with a `400` carrying the reason, and never writes inside your
repository.

## Install

`dsh-code-impact` is a DSH host bundle: zero dependencies, plain ESM, one patch row.

```bash
# from GitHub (or any published tarball / registry package)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Locael123/dsh-code-impact
dsh web    # restart: the host half of a plugin is imported once, at boot
```

```bash
# from a local checkout
plugin_manager install_bundle <absolute path>/dsh-code-impact
```

Manual install — only if the package is already resolvable from the profile's `node_modules`
(`plugin_manager` does that for you; a bare `cordis.yml` row alone will not):

```yaml
- id: dsh-code-impact
  name: dsh-code-impact
  config:
    maxFiles: 20000
```

The bundle ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, so the plugin manager path is preferred — it wires the
patch row, links the directory, and keeps `

plugins.description: Provision a separate DSH_HOME for a model relay, so relay traffic never shares your main Harness sessions or credentials.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-relay-isolation

[English](#english) | [中文](#中文)

---

## English

> **0.4.0 — provider-agnostic.** The plugin no longer hardcodes AgentRouter, a
> protocol, or a model list. You pass `provider` (api / baseURL / apiKeyEnv /
> models); `api: "auto"` probes `/v1/responses` and then `/v1/chat/completions`
> and records what actually works. `preset: "agentrouter"` stays available for
> that relay's endpoint switch and User-Agent fence. The host-side network tool
> moved to the standalone [`dsh-sandbox-net`](packages/sandbox-net) package, and
> a generated environment installs it automatically.

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that provisions **a separate `DSH_HOME`** for a
third-party model relay or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so relay traffic never
runs inside your main Harness profile.

### Why a separate home, not just a separate profile

A profile only separates **plugin composition**. Sessions, storages, and
`.credentials.yaml` live in `DSH_HOME` and are shared by every profile that uses
the same home — so a relay profile in `~/.dsh` still lists your main
conversations and can read every key you stored. This plugin creates a sibling
home instead:

```
~/.dsh            main Harness: official models, your keys, your sessions
~/.dsh-relay      relay home: one profile, one key, its own sessions
```

The isolated home holds **only** `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`; other credentials are
never copied.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-relay-isolation
```

### Use

The bundle registers one agent tool, `relay_isolation`:

| action | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | reports whether the isolated home exists, whether its profile is configured, whether the relay route is installed, whether a key is present |
| `setup` | creates or refreshes it; idempotent |
| `remove` | deletes it, including the sessions stored there; requires `force: true` |

Ask your agent: *"create an isolated relay environment"* — it calls
`relay_isolation` with `action: "setup"`. On Windows a double-click launcher is
written to the Desktop; elsewhere `~/.dsh-relay/launch.sh` is written and made
executable.

The launcher installs `dsh-llm-agentrouter` into the isolated profile on first
start, then boots `dsh` with `--port 0` and opens its own UI.

### What it generates

```
~/.dsh-relay/
  .credentials.yaml            only AGENTROUTER_API_KEY
  launch.cmd | launch.sh
  profiles/relay/
    package.json               bundles: dsh-base, dsh-web-app, dsh-llm-agentrouter
    cordis.yml
    cordis.patch.yml           default model + relay route with silent retry
    pnpm-workspace.yaml
```

The relay route and its request compatibility (client `User-Agent`, direct
transport for the domestic endpoint, tool-schema repair) come from
[`dsh-llm-agentrouter`](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-agentrouter). This
plugin configures it; it does not reimplement it.

### Network inside the sandbox

The Windows sandbox hands shell commands a token without network capability, so
`curl` inside the isolated environment cannot reach anything. Raising the mode
to `danger-full-access` would fix that by removing the sandbox — the wrong trade.

Instead the bundle registers a second tool, `relay_fetch`, which performs the
request **in the host process** (unsandboxed) against an explicit allowlist:

| Host | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `registry.npmjs.org` | package metadata and tarballs |
| `api.github.com`, `github.com`, `raw.githubusercontent.com` | repository discovery and file reads |
| `cdn.jsdelivr.net`, `awesome-dsh-plugin.com`, `dshmarket.com` | plugin catalog |

GET only, HTTPS only, 60 KB per call by default, 20 s timeout. The write boundary
is unchanged: the sandbox still confines the agent to its workspace.

Configuration:

```yaml
- id: relay-isolation
  name: dsh-relay-isolation
  config:
    allowedHosts: ['registry.npmjs.org']   # replaces the default list
```

### Permissions it gets

The isolated environment is provisioned to be **useful inside its box and unable
to reach outside it**:

| Capability | Default | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace read/write | yes | The launcher `cd`s into `<home>/workspace`; the sandbox pins `workspaceRoot` to that directory |
| Command execution | yes | Sandboxed; approval `ask` fails closed when nobody answers |
| Outbound npm / GitHub | yes | Needed to install the relay route; model traffic already goes to the relay |
| Credentials | only `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | Other keys in the main home are never copied |

**What it does not guarantee:** DSH's `workspace-write` bounds *writes*, not
*reads*. An agent inside the isolated environment can still read paths outside
its workspace. For a real boundary, run the launcher as a separate OS user or in
a VM.

### Relay-side limits

The Responses API is stateful: a follow-up request may reference an item created
by the previous one. A relay that spreads requests across several upstream
resources breaks that, and the upstream answers *"The requested item was created
under a different Azure OpenAI resource"*. No profile setting fixes this — the
relay has to pin a conversation to one upstream. Note also that `supportsStore`
is a completions-only switch: `openai-responses` rejects it and accepts
`supportsDeveloperRole`, `supportsMaxOutputTokens`, `supportsStrictMode`,
`supportsLongCacheRetention`.

### Limits

- It cannot isolate the **running** host: `DSH_HOME` is fixed when a process
  starts. Isolation applies to the environment it provisions.
- The generated profile is `relay`; the generated home is
  `$(dirname $DSH_HOME)/.dsh-<suffix>`.
- Installing the relay package needs network access on first launch.
- `remove` deletes that home, including its sessions. It refuses to run without
  `force: true`, and refuses to delete `DSH_HOME` itself.

---

## 中文

一个 DeepSeek Harness bundle，给第三方模型中转站（AgentRouter）**单独开一个
`DSH_HOME`**，让中转站流量不进入主 Harness profile。

### 为什么必须是独立 home，而不是独立 profile

profile 只隔离**插件组合**。会话、存储、`.credentials.yaml` 都在 `DSH_HOME`
里，同一个 home 下的所有 profile 共用——所以 `~/.dsh` 里再建一个 relay profile，
它照样列出你的主会话，也读得到你存的每个密钥。本插件建的是**兄弟目录**：

```
~/.dsh            主 Harness：官方模型、你的密钥、你的会话
~/.dsh-relay      中转站环境：一个 profile、一个密钥、自己的会话
```

隔离环境里**只**有 `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY`，其他凭据一律不复制。

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-relay-isolation
```

### 使用

装好后会注册一个 agent 工具 `relay_isolation`：

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 报告隔离环境是否存在、profile 是否已配置、中转站路由是否装好、有没有密钥 |
| `setup` | 创建或刷新（幂等） |
| `remove` | 删除，**连同里面的会话**；必须带 `force: true` |

直接对 agent 说「建一个中转站隔离环境」即可；Windows 上会在桌面写一个双击启动器，
其他平台写到 `~/.dsh-relay/launch.sh` 并加可执行位。

启动器首次运行会把 `dsh-llm-agentrouter` 装进隔离 profile，然后用 `--port 0`
起一个自己的界面。

### 沙箱里的网络

Windows 沙箱交给命令的是**无网络能力**的令牌，所以隔离环境里 `curl` 连不出去。把模式提到
`danger-full-access` 能解决，但那是拿掉沙箱——方向反了。

本 bundle 注册第二个工具 `relay_fetch`：请求在**宿主进程**里发出（不受沙箱限制），目标
主机走白名单（npm registry、GitHub、插件目录），GET only、HTTPS only、默认 60 KB、
20 秒超时。写入边界不变——沙箱仍然把 agent 锁在它的工作区里。

```yaml
- id: relay-isolation
  name: dsh-relay-isolation
  config:
    allowedHosts: ['registry.npmjs.org']   # 替换默认列表
```

### 权限模型

隔离环境是「盒子内够用、盒子外够不着」：

| 能力 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工作目录读写 | ✅ | 启动器会 `cd` 到 `<home>/workspace`，沙箱的 `workspaceRoot` 就是它 |
| 命令执行 | ✅ | 沙箱内执行；审批 `ask`，无人应答时 fail closed |
| 出网 npm / GitHub | ✅ | 装中转站路由需要；模型流量本来就走中转站 |
| 凭据 | 只有 `AGENTROUTER_API_KEY` | 主 home 里的其他 key 一律不复制 |

**它不保证的事**：DSH 的 `workspace-write` 限制的是**写**，不是**读**。隔离环境里的
agent 仍然可能读到工作区之外的路径。要拿到真正的边界，请用独立的操作系统账户或
虚拟机运行这个启动器。

### 中转站侧的限制

Responses API 是有状态的：后续请求可能引用上一跳创建的 item。如果中转站把请求分散到多个
上游资源上，这一点就会被打破，上游会回 *"The requested item was created under a different
Azure OpenAI resource"*。**这不是配置能修的**——得让中转站把同一段对话固定到同一个上游。
另外 `supportsStore` 是 completions 专有开关，`openai-responses` 不接受，它只接受
`supportsDeveloperRole`、`supportsMaxOutputTokens`、`supportsStrictMode`、
`supportsLongCacheRetention`。

### 边界

- 它**无法隔离正在运行的宿主**：`DSH_HOME` 在进程启动时固定，隔离对新建的环境生效；
- 中转站路由与请求兼容（`User-Agent`、国内端点直连、工具 schema 修补）来自
  [`dsh-llm-agentrouter`](https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-llm-agentrouter)，本插件只做配置；
- 首次启动需要联网安装该路由包；
- `remove` 会删掉整个 home（含会话），无 `force: true` 时拒绝执行，也拒绝删 `DSH_HOME`。

---

MIT

plugins.description: 九派多智能体协商 DSH 插件（钉钉版）：每人一个助理，在钉钉里约会议、排时间、团建投票
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-meeting-DD：钉钉版多智能体冲突协商插件

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

**基于钉钉的多智能体协商：排会、约周末团建、投票点奶茶。**

局域网版 [dsh-meeting](https://github.com/maximehu97/dsh-meeting) 的钉钉版。功能一样，助理之间的通信从局域网 A2A 换成了钉钉，不用在同一个网络里，扫码登录钉钉就能用。

## 解决什么问题

约一个三个人的会，常见的过程是：在群里问「周四谁有空」，等每个人翻日历回复，发现没有交集，再私聊某个人「你那个会能不能挪一下」，最后有人去订会议室、发邀请。更难的是「日历上根本没有空档」的时候：共享日历只认「忙 / 闲」，把能让的忙和不能让的忙都当成忙，找不到空档就只能放弃；人工协调又要说清原因（在去机场的车上、要接孩子），谁让步还要看面子。

dsh-meeting-DD 是一个 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件，把这些来回沟通交给每个人自己的 AI 助理。每个人在自己的电脑上跑一个 dsh 助理，助理以本人的钉钉身份，在钉钉单聊里和同事的助理互发协商报文，替各自的主人谈时间、谈口味：

- **每个助理只代表一个人**，只读写本机主人的日程、偏好和原始记录（聊天记录、外卖记录之类）。
- **助理之间在钉钉里直接谈**：发请求、回可用时段、求交集、提方案、确认，每一步都是一条真实的钉钉消息，本人在钉钉里能看到全过程，不需要中心服务器。
- **保护隐私**：对外只说「可用 / 勉强 / 需要本人点头」，不说具体原因。
- **找代价最小的让步**：没有共同空档时，助理把能让的忙（可以线上接入、可以缩短、可以顺延）当成有代价的选项，组合出一个代价最小的方案，再去问需要让步的那几个人。
- **本人拍板**：遇到只有本人能决定的事，助理不会替你答应，而是在你的页面弹出卡片，由你点「同意 / 不同意」。

![演示：8 个人的助理通过钉钉协商，报文在组织里的助理之间飞行（场景一：上级通知；场景四：冲突重约）](docs/images/demo.gif)

## 安装

前提：已经装好 DeepSeek Harness 网页版，并且这个 profile 的**默认模型可用**（已经登录 DeepSeek 账号，或者配好了 API Key），以及一个加入了公司钉钉组织的钉钉账号。不需要钉钉开放平台应用，也不需要填任何密钥。

1. 在终端运行一条命令：

   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maximehu97/dsh-meeting-dd/main/install.sh | bash
   ```

   它会从 GitHub 最新发布版下载安装包，装进 DSH 网页版（profile `web`），并顺带装好钉钉 CLI（[DingTalk Workspace CLI](https://github.com/DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli)）以及缺的 pnpm、dsh。

2. **重启 dsh web**。左侧栏会出现「📅 约会议·钉钉」，点开就是本机的助理页。也可以在浏览器里直接打开 `http://127.0.0.1:4600/`。
3. 页面会直接请你**扫码登录钉钉**：点「登录钉钉（扫码）」，浏览器打开钉钉授权页，用手机钉钉扫码、选公司、点「同意」。第一次用时钉钉可能提示「暂无 CLI 数据访问权限」，选公司管理员提交申请，管理员在钉钉里批准后自动完成登录。
4. 登录后不用选身份，下面这些都会自动完成：
   - 身份直接用你的钉钉姓名、部门、职位和主管；
   - 按你的钉钉账号生成一套示例日程（未来一周）、偏好和原始记录（周末安排、奶茶口味、体检备注等），每人不同，可以改成自己的真实安排；
   - 给本组织每位同事打一次招呼，装了插件的同事会自动出现在「👥 同事」里，没装的只会收到一条可以忽略的说明。

**更新**：再运行一次上面的命令，然后重启。会先卸掉旧版再装新版，钉钉不用重新扫码。本人数据保存在 `~/.dsh-meeting-dd`，更新和卸载都不会删除它。

插件只往 profile 里加两样东西：本机节点 `meeting-dd` 和助理 preset `meeting-dd`，不会改动这个 profile 的模型和会话设置。可以和局域网版 dsh-meeting 装在同一个 DSH 里，端口、数据目录、侧栏按钮都分开。

> 也可以在 [Releases](https://github.com/maximehu97/dsh-meeting-dd/releases) 下载 `dsh-meeting-dd-kit-<版本>.zip`，解压后运行 `./install.sh`。想单独建一个 profile：`DSH_PROFILE=meeting-dd ./install.sh`，再运行 `./start.sh`。

### 和同事试一试

两个人都装好、登录同一个钉钉组织，在「👥 同事」里互相显示「助理已接入」后：

| 剧本 | 发起人对助理说 | 看点 |
|---|---|---|
| 同级排会 | 「约 张三 明天下午开半小时会」 | SYN → SYN-ACK → PROPOSE → 本人确认 → CONFIRM，双方日程同时写入 |
| @ 某人 | 「@张三 @李四 周四下午开个一小时的方案会」 | @ 到的人就是协商对象，助理去找他们的助理谈，谈好再回复你 |
| 团建 + 奶茶 | 「这周末约大家出去玩半天，顺便团一波奶茶」 | 各自从原始记录里提取档案 → 求交 → 投票 → 下单 |

## 核心功能

### 1. 冲突协商：把开不成的会变成能开

对自己的助理说一句「约刘经理、赵经理开个双十一联合方案会，周四，一小时，越早越好」，助理会：

1. 通过钉钉向对方助理发 **SYN**（请求可用时段）；
2. 收到各自的 **SYN-ACK**，在本机算交集。对方只回「空闲 / 勉强 / 需本人点头」，不说原因；
3. 交集为空时，找代价最小的松绑：能线上接入的、能缩短的、能顺延的都算有代价的让步，排除任何碰到「不可动」安排的方案，向需要让步的人发 **RELAX**（松绑请求），对方本人在页面上点头；
4. 定下时段后发 **PROPOSE**，对方 **ACK**，助理订会议室、发 **CONFIRM**，各方日程同时写入。

上级插会时（**NOTICE**），下属的助理按主人的偏好处理冲突，比如把 1on1 顺延；被挤掉的会由发起人的助理自动重约。

| 助理页：协商结果和本人卡片 | 日程页：被挤掉的会重约到周五 |
|---|---|
| ![](docs/images/ipad-chat.png) | ![](docs/images/ipad-cal.png) |

### 2. 约周末团建、投票点奶茶

发起人说「这周末约大家出去玩半天，顺便团一波奶茶」，助理把请求同时发给同事的助理：

- **每个人都有自己的隐藏日程**。助理第一次被问到时，先读本人的原始记录（家庭群、备忘录、预约、体检备注……），自己整理出「走不开 / 勉强 / 本人点头可让」的时段和口味忌口，存进「🧠 记住的」。
- **对外只给忙闲，不给原因**，助理自动求交，必要时只问需要让步的那个人。
- 时间定下以后，发起方的助理发 **VOTE**，每个助理按主人的口味和忌口回 **BALLOT**（两家店各打 0–3 分，有忌口可以一票否决，并选好自己那杯），平票交给发起人拍板，最后下团单。

### 3. 消息和 @ 提及

- 在助理页里「@某人 …」，是交给你的助理去找他的助理办这件事。
- 想直接给某人发一句话（不经过助理），在「💭 消息」里私聊或建群，对方在钉钉里直接能看到，在钉钉里直接回的文字也会显示回来。
- 也可以让助理代劳，比如「帮我跟刘经理说一声我晚到十分钟」。

### 4. 用钉钉身份，自动发现同事

- 扫码后身份直接来自钉钉，不需要选演示人物。可以在「🧠 记住的」里改职位、部门和层级（层级决定谁对谁是上级通知、谁和谁是同级握手）。
- 登录后自动给本组织同事打招呼，装了插件的同事几秒内出现在「👥 同事」里。新同事入职后可以点「重新发现」，也可以按姓名搜索添加。
- 不在通讯录里的人，助理会先用 `find_colleague` 在钉钉里找；同名的会先问你选谁。

## 架构

每台电脑上的 dsh 进程里有两个部分，都由本插件的 bundle patch 插入：

| 组件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **本机节点** `dsh-meeting-dd` :4600 | 保存本人数据（日程、偏好、原始记录、消息、团单）；提供助理页（REST + SSE，只监听 127.0.0.1）；提供给助理用的 MCP 工具（求交、松绑、计票、下单、发报文）；负责钉钉收发 |
| **助理** preset `meeting-dd` | 用 profile 的默认模型。工具只有本机节点的 MCP 工具，没有 bash 或文件工具。插件在 dsh 进程里直接调用它，不需要额外的 A2A 端口 |

钉钉通道用官方 [DingTalk Workspace CLI](https://github.com/DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli)（`dws`），以本人身份收发：

1. 助理调用 `send_ding`，本机节点用 `dws chat +messages-send --as user` 给对方发一条钉钉单聊。上面是人能读懂的一句话（比如「🤖 李经理的助理 · 问空闲：……」），最后一行是机器读的 `⟦DSHM·1⟧{json}`，太长会自动拆成几条；
2. 对方节点用 `dws event consume user_im_message_receive_o2o_all` 长连接收到消息，交给对方的助理处理，对方助理调用 `reply_ding`，同样走钉钉单聊回来；
3. 人与人的私聊、群聊也走钉钉单聊，不经过助理。

本人确认有两道保护：`ask_owner` 会在本人页面弹卡片并一直等待；`grant_exemption`（同意占用本人保护的时段）只有在本人 30 分钟内点过同意时才会生效。

## 和局域网版的区别

| | dsh-meeting（局域网版） | dsh-meeting-DD（钉钉版） |
|---|---|---|
| 助理之间的协商报文 | A2A，直接连到对方电脑的端口 | 钉钉单聊，以本人钉钉身份发出（带 AI 标识） |
| 收信 | 本机 A2A 端口对局域网开放 | 钉钉事件长连接，不开放任何端口 |
| 找同事 | mDNS 自动发现 / IP / 邀请码 | 自动给本组织同事打招呼 / 按姓名搜索 |
| 身份 | 选示例公司里的角色或自己填 | 钉钉姓名、部门、职位，档案自动生成 |
| 要求 | 同一个局域网 | 同一个钉钉组织，各自扫码登录 |
| 端口 | 4500 / 41500（对局域网） | 4600（只对本机） |

## 安全说明

> [!NOTE]
> - 默认用钉钉 CLI 自带的应用登录，插件里没有任何密钥。用公司自建的企业内部应用登录是可选的，凭据只保存在本机 `~/.dsh-meeting-dd/dingtalk.json`（权限 600）。
> - 助理页只监听 127.0.0.1，写操作只接受本机页面发起的请求。
> - 协商报文以本人钉钉身份发出，对方在钉钉聊天里能看到全文（包括机器读的那一行）。助理的提示词要求只给忙闲、不给原因。
> - 只处理带协商标记的来信和已添加同事的普通回复，不读取、不导入其他钉钉聊天。
> - 不要和别的钉钉自动回复插件（比如 dsh-dingtalk）装在同一个 DSH 里，两个插件会同时处理同一条钉钉消息。
> - 电脑要开着、DSH 要在运行，助理才能收发。电脑睡眠期间对方发来的报文不会补处理，对方助理等到超时会告诉对方本人。

## 数据与重置

- 数据保存在 `~/.dsh-meeting-dd/state.json`，包括日程、档案、对话、消息和钉钉同事列表。
- 助理页右侧的「清空本轮」会清空对话和报文，日程保留。
- 🧠 页的「重新生成示例日程和记录」会换一套示例档案。

## 配置项

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里改 `meeting-dd` 条目（dsh 的 patch 会整份替换 config，改端口时用 `node lib/patch.mjs --port 4601` 生成完整叠加层）：

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `port` / `host` | 4600 / 127.0.0.1 | 助理页和本机 MCP |
| `dataDir` | `~/.dsh-meeting-dd` | 本人数据 |
| `dwsPath` / `dwsProfile` | `dws` / 空 | 钉钉 CLI 路径；多组织时指定 `corpId:userId` |
| `aiTag` | true | 助理发出的钉钉消息带 AI 标识 |
| `replyTimeoutMin` | 30 | 等对方助理回复的最长分钟数 |
| `autoDiscover` | true | 登录后自动给本组织同事打招呼 |
| `loopDir` / `simDir` | 空 | 测试用：本机假信箱 / 单账号模拟（见下） |

## 开发

```bash
npm test                 # 协议单元测试：两个节点通过本机假信箱打招呼、私聊、协商、分片
node scripts/build.mjs   # 打包 dist/ 下的 tgz 和独立安装包 zip（依赖已打进 tgz）
```

本机联调不联系真人：设置 `DSH_MEETING_DD_LOOP=/tmp/ddloop`，再用不同端口起几个节点（`DSH_MEETING_DD_LOOP_NAME=李经理 DSH_MEETING_DD_PORT=4611 ./kit/start.sh`），它们之间通过本机假信箱协商。只有一个钉钉账号时，改用 `DSH_MEETING_DD_SIM=~/.dsh-meeting-dd-sim`：几个节点共用这个账号，报文发到钉钉「我自己」会话里，真实经过钉钉。

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | cordis 插件入口（配置 schema、启停本机节点） |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器端：DSH 侧栏「约会议·钉钉」和主区页面 |
| `lib/node.mjs` | 本机节点：状态、工具实现、钉钉身份和同事发现、HTTP |
| `lib/dingtalk.mjs` | 钉钉通道：报文编解码和分片，DWS / 本机假信箱 / 单账号模拟三种收发 |
| `lib/runner.mjs` | 在 dsh 进程里直接调用本机助理 |
| `lib/gen.mjs` | 扫码后自动生成示例日程、偏好和原始记录 |
| `lib/mcp.mjs` | MCP 工具清单和 Streamable HTTP 处理 |
| `lib/engine.mjs` | 带日期的忙闲计算、求交、松绑、计票 |
| `lib/prompt.mjs` | 助理提示词 |
| `web/` | 助理页（横版平板样式） |
| `kit/` | 独立安装包里的 install / login / start / stop 脚本 |
| `install.sh` | 一条命令安装：从 GitHub 最新发布版下载安装包并运行 |
| `docs/images/` | README 截图和演示动图（用示例人物的数据渲染） |

plugins.description: One-click upgrades, version history and rollback for plugins on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-upgrader

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-upgrader.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-upgrader)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-upgrader.svg)](./LICENSE)

> 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的「插件」页补上**一键升级**和**版本历史 / 回滚**。

DSH 自带的插件页能装、能卸、能看已安装列表，但缺两件事：一次把全部插件升到最新，以及退回某个旧版本。
这个插件在插件页里加一个「版本」标签，把这两件事补齐。

[English](./README.en.md) · 中文

![版本标签](./screenshots/history.png)

## 功能

- **一键升级** —— 一次把全部可升级插件升到最新版，带进度、逐项结果和失败原因。
- **多选升级** —— 勾选任意几个插件，只升级选中的这些。
- **版本历史 / 回滚** —— 展开任意插件即可看到已发布的全部版本（含发布时间与引擎要求），点一下切到那个版本。
- **一键跳 GitHub** —— 每行的 `GH` 按钮打开插件仓库主页；点版本号直接进该版本的 GitHub 发布页。

## 界面位置

插件页顶部标签栏多出一个「版本」标签，与「已安装」「发现」并列：

- 顶部统计：可升级数量 / 已安装数量 / 每个插件的版本数
- 「一键升级」升全部可升级插件；下面一条选择栏负责「升级选中」
- 「检查更新」强制刷新 registry 缓存（默认缓存 5 分钟）
- 搜索框按包名过滤
- 每个插件一行，展开「历史 (n)」后是该插件的完整版本列表
- `GH` 打开仓库主页（没有仓库的插件不显示该按钮）
- 版本列表里每个版本号本身就是链接，点开直接进 GitHub 的发布页：
  - 该版本打过 tag → `releases/tag/v<version>`（tag 是否真实存在由 GitHub tag 列表确认，
    不是猜的，所以不会点进 404）
  - 该版本没打 tag，或 GitHub 列表读不到（限流 / 离线）→ 退回仓库的发布列表 `releases`，
    不在页面上放一个点进去是 404 的版本号

![展开历史版本](./screenshots/selection.png)

## 安装

在「插件」页的**发现**标签里搜索 `dsh-plugin-upgrader`，点安装即可。
桌面版请用它自带的插件管理界面安装，命令行改动不了正在运行的桌面 profile。

用 `dsh` 命令行（把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-upgrader
```

从源码安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zuwenyin/dsh-plugin-upgrader.git
cd dsh-plugin-upgrader
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

装好后打开「插件」页，顶部会多出「版本」标签。不需要重新构建，也不用重启。

## 工作原理

浏览器端读不到 profile 的依赖清单，也无法可靠直连 npm（CORS、私有源、token），
因此所有包操作都放在宿主端：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/plugin-upgrader/overview` | 已安装插件 + 各插件已发布版本（registry packument，5 分钟缓存，10 秒超时） |
| `POST /api/plugin-upgrader/job` | 提交一批升级 / 切换步骤，立即返回 job id |
| `GET /api/plugin-upgrader/job?id=…` | 轮询进度与逐项结果 |
| `POST /api/plugin-upgrader/cancel` | 中断当前步骤 |

所有路由仅限本机回环访问：批量操作会安装软件包，配对设备或跨站页面一律拒绝。

### 为什么「切换版本」是「先卸载再安装」

`pluginManager.installBundle` 对已安装的包名会以 `already-installed` 拒绝，
所以换版本必须是 remove + install（官方「更新」走的也是同一条路）。
旧版本号会回传给界面，用于提示这是降级。

### enabled 状态保留

卸载会丢掉插件原有的启用 / 禁用状态，因此每一步在安装完成后会按操作前的状态
重新 `setBundleEnabled`，禁用中的插件升级后仍然是禁用状态。

### 同一时刻只跑一批

宿主端一次只允许一个 job。重复提交会拿到 `409 busy`（带正在跑的那个 job id），
界面据此**接管**那一批的进度显示，而不是弹一条看不懂的错误：

- 新开一个插件页标签、或在进度跑着时再点「一键升级」，都会看到正在进行的那一批
- `overview` 里带 `active` 字段，标签页一挂载就能接上正在跑的任务
- job 每隔几秒写一次心跳时间戳，宿主重启后遗留的「僵尸 job」会按心跳超时自动作废，
  不会永久占着位置让之后所有升级都撞 `busy`

主进程重启会让正在跑的 job 中断，界面会把这种情况显示为失败而不是永远转圈。

## 项目结构

```
dsh-plugin-upgrader/
├── src/                  源码（TypeScript）
│   ├── index.ts          宿主端入口：路由注册、job 调度
│   ├── host/             宿主端逻辑（Node，无 DOM）
│   │   ├── overview.ts   组装 overview 载荷
│   │   ├── registry.ts   registry packument 拉取 / 裁剪、GitHub tag 列表
│   │   ├── install.ts    单步安装 + enabled 状态恢复
│   │   ├── bundle.ts     插件元数据（来源分类、多语言字段、图标）
│   │   ├── repo.ts       仓库 URL 归一化
│   │   ├── version.ts    semver 比较、发布页链接
│   │   ├── http.ts       回环校验、JSON 读写
│   │   └── manager.ts    宿主 pluginManager 服务的最小类型契约
│   └── client/           浏览器端（拆成模块，由 esbuild 打成一个文件）
│       ├── index.ts      createPlugin(require)：槽位注册入口
│       ├── components/   Tab / PluginRow / VersionLine / JobPanel
│       ├── copy.ts       zh / en 文案
│       ├── styles.ts     作用域 CSS
│       ├── hooks.ts      locale 订阅、overview 拉取
│       ├── api.ts        fetch 封装、job 轮询
│       ├── format.ts     版本号 / 日期 / 外部链接
│       ├── env.ts        window 上的最小类型声明
│       └── types.ts      载荷类型
├── lib/                  构建产物（git 忽略，`npm run build` 生成）
│   ├── index.js          宿主端入口（tsc 输出）
│   ├── host/*.js         宿主端模块 + .d.ts
│   └── client.js         浏览器端单文件 bundle（含 __ModuleLoader__ 包装）
├── scripts/build.mjs     构建脚本：tsc 编译宿主端 + esbuild 打包 client
├── test/                 node:test 单元测试（.ts，Node 24 直接剥离类型）
├── locale/               （保留）语言包
├── assets/icon.svg       图标
├── cordis.patch.yml      bundle 注册
└── package.json
```

浏览器端虽然拆成了多个 `.ts` 模块，但最终由 esbuild 打成一个 `lib/client.js`，
外面套上 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) { … } })`。
运行时它只能 `require('react')` 这类由宿主提供的模块，不能 require 自己的其它文件，
所以「拆模块」只发生在源码层，产物仍然是单文件。

## 开发

```bash
npm run build      # tsc 编译宿主端 + esbuild 打包 client → lib/
npm run typecheck  # tsc 检查 src 和 test
npm test           # node:test 单元测试（.ts 直接运行）
npm run check      # 以上全部（typecheck + build + test）
```

宿主端在 `src/index.ts`（`webServer` 前缀路由 `/api/plugin-upgrader`），
浏览器端在 `src/client/index.ts`（注册 `plugins.tab` 槽位）。

改完代码后必须重新 `npm run build`（profile 里的 `link:` 指向本目录，
但加载的是 `lib/`，不是 `src/`）。然后让宿主重新加载本插件即可，无需重启应用：
先 `pluginManager.setBundleEnabled(name, false)` 再 `setBundleEnabled(name, true)`。

## 发布

见 [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md)。首次手动发一次，之后打 `v*` tag 由 CI 通过 npm trusted publishing 自动发布：

```bash
npm publish --access public   # 仅首次
```

## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Tide & Timber (潮汐木色) — a coastal light/dark theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, built on the official ThemeRuntime alias-token layer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Tide & Timber · 潮汐木色

一套给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的**海岸线配色主题**：白天的「海盐晨雾」与夜里的「潮汐夜航」，都只通过官方 `ThemeRuntime` 的 `--dsw-alias-*` token 层叠加，不注入壁纸、不改布局、不劫持 DOM。

| Light — Salt & Timber | Dark — Twilight Cove |
| --- | --- |
| ![light](previews/light.png) | ![dark](previews/dark.png) |

> 2026-10-20 已在本机 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 通过 profile patch + 符号链接热挂载，并用 headless Chromium 做了 light/dark 双模式计算样式与截图验证（详见 `dsh-daily-learning/2026-10-20.md` §4）。

- **Light — Salt & Timber**：暖象牙沙、海玻璃青、浮木墨色。主按钮是深海青，选中/链接是潮水绿。
- **Dark — Twilight Cove**：落潮后的深蓝绿、月光海玻璃、暖铜色状态点。整体低饱和、长时间阅读不刺眼。
- **自适应**：跟随 DSH 自带的 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 设置，不需要另设开关。
- **可热插拔**：主题注册在 `ctx.effect` 内，禁用插件或热重载会精确撤回这一层 token。

## 安装

需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** 及以上（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 的第三方主题入口在该版本提供）。

```sh
# 直接从仓库安装（当前可用）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zys2026/dsh-theme-tide
```

装完重启 dsh（或在插件管理器里重载），主题会跟随 DSH 自带的「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」设置自动切换，不需要额外开关。

**卸载 / 临时停用**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-tide   # 卸载
```

或在插件管理器里把 `dsh-theme-tide` 设为禁用——主题注册在 `ctx.effect` 内，禁用会精确撤回这一层 token，不会残留。

**要求**：主题只通过官方 `--dsw-alias-*` token 覆盖上色，不改布局、不注入壁纸、不劫持 DOM；因此 DSH 升级若增删 token，未覆盖的新 token 会回落到内置默认色，不会破坏界面。

## 设计要点

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 扩展点 | `ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, tokens)`（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 官方第三方主题入口） |
| 覆盖范围 | 0.2.1-rc.2 声明的全部 **107 个 `--dsw-alias-*`** token，每个都提供 light/dark 一对值 |
| 运行时依赖 | 无；`client.js` 是零依赖 IIFE，不需要 React、three.js 或打包器 |
| 持久化 | 不写设置、不写 localStorage；主题随插件的启用/禁用生效 |
| Host 半侧 | 空（只用于让 Loader 发现 `./client`） |

## 可验证质量（2026-10-20 审计）

`tools/audit.mjs` 会对照官方 token 契约做覆盖率检查，并对 21 组关键「文字/背景」和「图标/背景」组合计算 WCAG 2.x 对比度：

```sh
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs                 # 控制台表格
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --json          # 机器可读
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --write-preview # 写入 previews/audit.md
```

当前结果（light 与 dark 两套）：

- **覆盖率 107/107**：与 `dsh-client-ui-theme@0.2.1-rc.2` 的 alias 清单完全一致（含 `onboarding-checkbox-border`、`settings-card-stroke` 两个边角 token）。
- **必需的 21 组配对全部达到 WCAG AA**（正文/次级/三级/说明文字、链接、代码块、Toast、主按钮、状态色、菜单图标等）。
- 审计还发现并修掉了 3 个真实问题：light 的 `label-tertiary`（4.31→4.78）、`label-caption`（3.06→4.56）、dark 的 `state-warn-label` 与 `state-warn-tertiary` 配色错位（1.36→9.35）。
- `border-l3` / `scrollbar-bg-l1` 与背景的对比度低于 3:1 属**刻意的低对比装饰**（与官方内置主题同量级），审计标记为 advisory，不阻断。

完整报告：[previews/audit.md](previews/audit.md)。

## 安装

### 方式 A：作为 bundle 安装（推荐，持久）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/Users/ys/Documents/deepseek/dsh-theme-tide
```

然后重启 DSH（或让插件管理器在 HMR 开启时热挂载）。插件的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 会插入 `dsh-theme-tide` 行，`dsh.client.immediately` 让它在页面启动时立即应用。

### 方式 B：运行中热挂载（本次会话采用）

1. 把包链接进 profile：
   `ln -s "$(pwd)" ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-theme-tide`
2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-theme-tide
         name: 'dsh-theme-tide'
         config: {}
   ```

3. `dsh-hmr` 监听 profile patch 变化，会重组合成并热挂载；页面无需重启 Host。
4. 若页面没有自动应用，刷新一次页面即可；Host 重启后该行依然存在。

## 开发

```sh
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/build.mjs             # 生成 client.js
node --check dsh-theme-tide/client.js           # 语法检查
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs             # token 覆盖 + WCAG AA
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --write-preview  # 更新 previews/audit.md
```

- `src/palette.mjs`：两份完整调色板（唯一需要改的颜色文件）
- `src/official-tokens.json`：0.2.1-rc.2 官方 alias token 契约快照（107 个）
- `src/client.template.js`：浏览器半侧 IIFE 模板
- `tools/build.mjs`：校验两份调色板 key 一致、全部为 `--dsw-alias-*`，注入模板生成 `client.js`
- `tools/audit.mjs`：覆盖率 + WCAG 2.x 对比度审计（零依赖，可复用为通用主题检查器）

## 卸载

删除 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `dsh-theme-tide` insert 行，再删除 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-theme-tide` 链接即可；页面刷新后恢复默认配色。

## 兼容性

- 构建/验证环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 0.2.1-rc.2，`overrideTokens` 与 `ThemeTokenModes` 契约）。
- 第三方主题 id 属于进程内扩展；本主题刻意**不注册新 theme id**，而是叠加 token 层，因此与官方 Appearance 的 light/dark/system 完全兼容。
- 若未来 DSH 新增 alias token，未覆盖的 token 会回退到内置调色板；在 `src/palette.mjs` 补齐即可。

---

English: **Tide & Timber** is a dependency-free coastal light/dark theme for the DSH Web GUI. It registers a `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens` layer covering every `--dsw-alias-*` token in 0.2.1-rc.2 (107 tokens, light+dark pairs), follows the built-in Appearance preference, and retracts cleanly when the plugin is disabled or hot-reloaded. No wallpaper, no DOM overrides, no settings writes.

plugins.description: Prompt, reasoning and response translation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Prompt Translation

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

适用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的插件：按需翻译用户提示词、模型返回的思考内容和回答。

在多语言对话中，输入语言、模型生成语言和阅读语言可能不同。本插件把翻译接入 DSH 的对话流程，并提供可随时修改的设置：

1. 在「插件 → dsh-prompt-translation」中配置原始语言、目标语言和翻译方式；
2. 分别选择是否翻译用户提示词、思考内容和输出内容；
3. 在输入框「权限」图标右侧使用「翻译」菜单，快捷启停翻译并切换语言。

插件由两半组成：Host 半端负责翻译接口、已有模型调用和对话拦截；Web 客户端半端提供设置卡片和快捷菜单。配置保存在 DSH 当前 Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中，无需独立存储。设置影响该 Profile 的所有会话，修改后无需重启插件。

## 为什么需要

不同任务对翻译的需求不同，单纯要求主模型“用某种语言回答”无法覆盖所有环节：

- **跨语言输入**：发送前将用户提示词转换成目标语言，同时保留系统提示词和附件结构。
- **阅读模型输出**：只翻译思考与回答，保留用户原始输入。
- **复用已有服务**：选择传统翻译 API，或使用 DSH 中已有的提供商、模型和推理强度配置。
- **临时切换语言**：在输入框直接调整，无需离开当前对话反复打开设置。

插件提供内容级开关，不需要修改 Agent loop 或在每条提示词里重复附加翻译指令。

## 特性

- **独立内容开关**：用户提示词、思考内容和输出内容分别控制，系统提示词不翻译。
- **自动检测语言**：原始语言支持自动检测；目标语言明确指定，提供常用语言选项。
- **传统翻译与智能体翻译**：支持百度、Google、DeepL、微软官方 API，以及 DSH 已配置的模型。
- **输入框快捷菜单**：「权限」右侧的翻译按钮支持启停和语言切换。
- **实时持久化配置**：使用 DSH 设置服务保存，并在并发写入冲突时重新读取后重试一次。
- **原文展示与翻译对照**：聊天气泡显示用户原文；轨迹中的用户记录可在「预览」和「原始内容」查看原文、实际发送的译文及语言方向；助手记录中的思考和回答也分别显示翻译前后内容。
- **结构化内容保护**：工具调用参数、工具结果、注入上下文、图片和文件块保持原样。

## 安装

插件版本与 DSH 版本对应关系矩阵如下：

| 插件版本 | 适配的 DSH 版本 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.0 ~ 0.1.1 | ≥0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| ≥0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.1 |

以下方式都将插件加入指定 Profile（以 `web` 为例）。本包包含 `cordis.patch.yml`，DSH 会自动挂载 Host 半端并加载 Web 客户端模块，无需另写组合配置。

### 从 npm 安装

包发布后执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-translation
```

### 从 GitHub 安装

仓库发布后执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EPCN-fla/dsh-prompt-translation
```

Git 源安装需要允许包管理器执行 `prepare`，安装开发依赖并构建 `lib/`。若禁止安装脚本，请使用预构建的 npm 包或 tarball。

### 从 tarball 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/EPCN-fla/dsh-prompt-translation.git
cd dsh-prompt-translation
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-prompt-translation-<version>.tgz
```

CI 不上传安装包或测试证据，也不创建 GitHub Release；需要本地安装包时请按上述步骤构建。

### 本地开发

开发期可以指向已构建的工作副本，每次修改源码后重新执行 `npm run build`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-prompt-translation
```

安装后重启 DSH Web 并刷新页面。执行 `dsh --profile web --dump-config`，确认输出包含 ID 为 `prompt-translation` 的插件行。

## 使用

### 1. 配置翻译方式

打开「插件 → dsh-prompt-translation」。插件默认关闭翻译；展开翻译卡片，选择翻译类型、配置服务后，勾选「启用翻译」并保存。卡片底部可保存设置或放弃修改。

| 传统翻译服务 | 所需配置 | 接口 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 百度 | App ID、密钥 | 官方通用翻译 API |
| Google | Cloud Translation API Key | Basic v2 |
| DeepL | API Key、Free / Pro 选择 | `/v2/translate` |
| 微软 | Translator API Key、资源区域（按资源要求） | Translator v3 |

密钥通过 DSH 设置接口交给 Host，由 secret 字段保存；浏览器不直接调用供应商。密钥输入框留空保留已有值，切换服务时必须填写新服务的密钥。删除凭据可在 DSH 组件配置中清空 `apiKey`。

选择「智能体」时，填写已有提供商 ID、模型 ID，以及可选的推理强度。候选项来自 DSH 模型目录，也支持手动填写已有 ID。推理强度必须受该模型支持，留空使用模型默认值。辅助翻译调用不提供工具，不会再次进入翻译链路，会产生额外模型请求和费用。自动回译会额外调用所选服务检测本轮用户语言；传统 API 读取检测元数据，模型模式使用独立语言检测请求。

### 2. 选择语言和翻译内容

选择「原始语言 → 目标语言」，再独立勾选用户提示词、思考内容和输出内容。原始语言可设为自动检测。

**用户提示词按“原始 → 目标”翻译，思考与回答译回原始语言。** 例如 `简体中文 → 日本語` 会把输入译成日语，并把选中的思考、回答译回中文。原始语言为自动检测时，使用本轮用户输入确定回译语言；不同会话互不影响。无法可靠检测时会报错，请明确选择原始语言。只需要回译时可以关闭用户提示词翻译。

**同语言时是否调用翻译服务：** 以下规则适用于已启用相应翻译开关的非空文本。

| 场景 | 当前行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 显式选择相同原始和目标语言，例如 `简体中文 → 简体中文` | 用户提示词直接跳过翻译，不调用翻译 API 或模型。 |
| 原始语言为自动检测 | 仍会调用所选翻译服务；即使检测结果与目标语言相同，目前也不会据此跳过后续提示词翻译。 |
| 思考与回答回译 | 使用 `自动检测 → 本轮用户语言`，即使模型已经使用该语言输出，仍会调用翻译服务。 |

翻译前后文本相同不代表没有调用服务：可能已经发出请求，只是返回了相同文本，仍可能产生延迟和费用。

语言选项包括简体中文、繁体中文、英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、俄语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、阿拉伯语和印地语；实际可用性取决于供应商。

在已有会话的输入框左下角，点击「权限」右侧的翻译图标，可以快捷启停和切换语言。图标划线表示关闭，无划线表示开启；弹窗使用“语言下拉框 → 语言下拉框”单行布局。修改作用于**当前 Profile 的所有会话**。

### 3. 生效时机与优先级

- 保存后，下一次用户提交读取新配置；一轮提示词与回译共用该轮的配置快照，正在生成的回答不会被后续编辑切换服务或回译语言。
- 用户提示词在 `agent/pre-step` 阶段翻译，保留原消息 ID；历史提示词不会在后续工具步骤重复翻译。
- 系统提示词、工具调用参数、工具结果、注入上下文、图片和文件块不参与翻译。标题生成、压缩等辅助模型调用不进入本插件的输出翻译。
- 思考与输出在完整文本块生成后翻译，再交给 DSH 展示和持久化；启用的内容不再逐 token 展示。
- 输入翻译或语言检测失败时，原始用户消息仍会记录并显示，然后在调用主模型前明确报错；不会静默将原文继续发送。取消会传播到翻译调用，卸载会撤销监听器并取消进行中的翻译。

## 配置存储格式

设置命名空间和 Loader 行 ID 均为 `prompt-translation`。用户设置保存在当前 Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 对应行的 `config` 中，例如：

```yaml
- id: prompt-translation
  name: dsh-prompt-translation
  config:
    enabled: true
    source: auto
    target: zh
    type: agent
    provider: your-existing-provider
    model: your-existing-model
    reasoningEffort: low
    userPrompt: false
    reasoning: true
    output: true
    timeoutMs: 60000
    maxChars: 2000
```

提供商、模型和推理强度需要替换成实际支持的值；使用默认推理强度时删除 `reasoningEffort`。部署方也可以在组合层同一插件行的 `config` 中预置配置。

传统翻译配置使用 `type: traditional`，并填写 `engine`（`baidu` / `google` / `deepl` / `microsoft`）、`apiKey`，以及对应服务的 `appId`、`region` 或 `deeplFree`。不要将真实密钥提交到仓库。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | 启用翻译 |
| `source` / `target` | `auto` / `en` | 原始语言与目标语言 |
| `type` / `engine` | `traditional` / `google` | 翻译类型与传统服务 |
| `userPrompt` / `reasoning` / `output` | `true` / `false` / `false` | 三类内容开关 |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单个文本块翻译的总超时，范围 1000–300000 毫秒 |
| `maxChars` | `2000` | 单次请求 Unicode 字符上限，范围 100–4000；百度还受 6000 UTF-8 字节上限约束 |

## 支持范围与已知限制

- Web 界面提供设置和快捷按钮。其他界面可使用 Host 翻译链路，但没有本插件的快捷菜单；Windows/macOS 未单独验收。
- 新处理的用户提示词同时保存原文与实际发送的译文。聊天气泡显示原文，主模型及后续模型历史仍使用译文；轨迹选择用户记录后，「预览」和「原始内容」显示两者。「原始内容」是该记录的文本块对照，精确持久化结构可在来源数据中查看。旧消息未保存原文，不能事后可靠恢复。
- 禁用/卸载客户端后，宿主默认渲染器会显示模型侧译文；原文元数据仍留在日志，重新启用后恢复原文展示。已生成的思考、回答依旧持久化为译文。
- 新完成翻译的助手思考和回答块会保存原文，轨迹选择「助手」记录后，可在「预览」和「原始内容」查看翻译前后内容；预览中的思考区域可能需要展开。聊天继续只展示译文，工具调用不增加翻译对照。没有翻译或旧记录未保存原文时保持原样。
- 文本变化后会清除与原文绑定的供应商 replay 元数据。依赖原生推理签名的模型续聊尚未进行真实供应商验证。
- 只翻译供应商实际返回的思考文本，无法获取未公开的内部推理。完整块翻译会增加展示延迟。
- 长文本优先按空白、句子或段落边界分段。传统 API 不保证代码和 Markdown 逐字不变；模型提示会要求保留代码、链接和占位符，但质量仍取决于模型。
- 快捷按钮通过官方左侧插槽挂载，再按当前输入框的权限 `data-slot` 锚点定位；锚点缺失时回退到原插槽。其他未验证的宿主版本可能改变布局。
- 四个已验证版本的完整 Web 测试使用真实宿主服务，仅外部模型为确定性适配器，不证明真实供应商的翻译质量、限流、账单或签名续聊。

可以在快捷菜单关闭翻译，或在 Plugins 页面禁用插件。卸载后重启 Profile 并刷新页面，已保存的译文会保留：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-prompt-translation
```

## 开发

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run test:scripts
npm run build
npm run pack:check
npm run test:browser

# 完整 Web 验证：安装精确版本的隔离宿主，再运行
npm run host:install -- 0.2.1-rc.2
npm run test:host -- 0.2.1-rc.2
```

`npm run check` 汇总类型检查、测试、构建和安装包检查。构建输出在 `lib/`，安装包与证据在 `artifacts/`。Chrome 默认路径可通过 `CHROME_PATH` 覆盖。`.npmrc` 使用 `legacy-peer-deps=true`，宿主安装脚本按精确版本补齐必需 peer，避免混装 DSH 预发布版本。

| 文件 | 覆盖 |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/translation.test.ts` | 四家 API 协议、语言映射、分段、脱敏、模型调用和取消 |
| `tests/direction.test.ts` | 回译方向、供应商语言检测、会话隔离、失败保留与取消 |
| `tests/presentation.test.ts` | 原文持久化、轨迹对照、历史消息兼容与显示适配器卸载 |
| `tests/pipeline.test.ts` | 用户来源过滤、消息身份、流式文本块和工具数据保护 |
| `tests/client.test.tsx` | 配置保存、冲突重试、密钥保护、异步竞态与控件清理 |
| `tests/loader.test.ts` | 真实 Cordis Loader 加载构建入口、翻译链路和卸载 |
| `scripts/ci.test.mjs` | CI 矩阵、依赖版本选择、失败汇总和触发策略 |
| `scripts/release-*.test.mjs` | 发布版本策略、标签匹配与注册表错误门禁 |
| `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs` | 构建后的浏览器模块、按钮位置、桌面与移动视口 |
| `scripts/full-host-smoke.mjs` | 精确版本的完整 Web 冷启动、配置重载和用户回合 |

CI 仅在 PR 和 `v*` 标签推送时触发，普通分支推送不运行。PR 从 `package.json` 的 `dshCompatibility` 读取精确版本矩阵，每个 DSH 版本独立一个 job，选择对应 DSH/Cordis 开发依赖后依次验证 Node 22、24（复用同一份锁文件）；包含类型检查、单元及脚本测试、构建、安装包和浏览器检查，并在 Node 22 上运行完整 Web 宿主检查。Node 22 失败不会阻止 Node 24 验证，结果写入 Actions Summary。`v*` 标签独立执行版本门禁、构建和 npm OIDC 发布，不运行测试，也不依赖 PR job；打标签前应确保对应提交的 PR 检查通过。预发布使用 `next`，稳定版使用 `latest` 并禁止版本回退。CI 不上传 artifacts，也不创建 GitHub Release；临时安装包和测试证据仅留在 runner。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Git status bar for DeepSeek Harness: repo, branch, changes and SHA above the composer, with branch switching and a diff pane.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-git-bar

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds one ambient row above the composer showing
the Session's git context:

```
⎇ main · dsh-git-bar · 3 处改动 · ↑2 ↓1 · a1b2c3d
```

![the row, on the same line as the workspace and mode selectors](docs/preview.png)

- repository name and root
- the branch the Session runs on, or `游离 HEAD` / `detached HEAD` when the HEAD
  is not on a branch
- working-tree change totals (staged / unstaged / untracked in the tooltip)
- ahead/behind counts against the upstream branch
- short commit id — clickable, opening that commit on the origin remote
  (GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket commit routes are all handled) — and a
  `链接工作树` / `linked worktree` marker when the directory is a linked
  `git worktree`, or a `N 个工作树` marker when the repository has more than one
- every label is plain text: select it and copy it

The row refreshes every 8 seconds, on window focus, and when the Session
changes. Reading it never touches the repository; two interactions deliberately
do:

- **click the branch** — a searchable popover lists every local branch with its
  upstream, ahead/behind and dirty state, marks the current one, and can check one
  out or create a new branch from the current HEAD;
- **click the change count** — opens the working tree in the right-hand Sidebar
  as a `工作区改动` tab: the changed files, and the unified diff of the file you
  pick, untracked files included (diffed against `/dev/null`);
- **click the worktree marker** — lists every worktree of the repository with its
  branch and change count. `在此新建会话` opens a new Session in that worktree's
  directory (a worktree is a directory, so a Session is never moved between
  them), and `复制路径` copies it. A branch already checked out in another
  worktree is greyed out in the branch popover with the worktree that holds it,
  instead of failing with git's `already checked out` after the click.
- nothing here silently scrolls away: a drag that selects text does not also open
  a popover.

![branch popover](docs/preview-branches.png)

![working tree in the sidebar](docs/preview-changes.png)

## Install

From a Git checkout (pin the commit; add `&path:/plugins/dsh-git-bar` when the
package is not at the repository root):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/mjnhmd/dsh-git-bar.git#2d3e0408376127196a4c18e8b1e1c79389a166f5"
```

From npm, or from a local checkout during development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-git-bar@0.1.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/plugins/dsh-git-bar
```

The Host half loads at startup, so restart the app after the first install; the
Client half is served on the next page load.

## Publish

Market index (add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**):
<https://mjnhmd.github.io/dsh-git-bar/market/index.json>

DSH ships no index of its own: a plugin market is a JSON file (format 1) you host
yourself and add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**. `docs/market-index.example.json`
is a ready template, `scripts/validate-index.mjs` checks it against DSH's own
validator, and [docs/PUBLISH.zh.md](docs/PUBLISH.zh.md) walks through pushing the
repository, publishing to npm, and publishing the index.

## Host API

`GET /dsh-git-bar/info?sessionId=<id>[&dir=<absolute path>]`

- admitted through the harness browser session (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`),
  so it is unreachable without the GUI's own credentials;
- the directory comes from the Session store first; `dir` is only a fallback for
  a Session the store does not know, and must be absolute;
- replies with `{ dir, repository: null | { root, name, branch, detached, sha,
  commitUrl, remote, dirty: { changed, staged, unstaged, untracked }, upstream,
  ahead, behind, worktree: { linked, mainRoot, count } } }`;
- `commitUrl` is derived from the `origin` remote: the scp, `ssh://`, `git://`
  and http(s) forms all normalize to `https://host/owner/repo`, and the commit
  route follows the host (GitHub `/commit/`, GitLab `/-/commit/`, Bitbucket
  `/commits/`). A local-path remote yields `null` and the id stays plain text.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/branches?sessionId=<id>` — `{ branches: [{ name, current,
upstream, ahead, behind, subject, checkedOutIn }], dirty }`, where
`checkedOutIn` is the worktree path holding that branch (a branch can only be
checked out in one worktree at a time).

`GET /dsh-git-bar/worktrees?sessionId=<id>` — `{ root, worktrees: [{ path, name,
branch, detached, sha, bare, locked, prunable, main, current, dirty }] }`, each
worktree costing one `status` call for its own change count.

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/checkout` `{ sessionId, branch }` — `{ branch,
created: false }`; 409 when git refuses (local changes, unknown branch).

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/create` `{ sessionId, name, from? }` — `{ branch,
created: true }`; the name is validated with `git check-ref-format --branch`.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/changes?sessionId=<id>` — `{ files: [{ path, status, staged,
additions, deletions }], dirty, truncated }`, capped at 500 files.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/diff?sessionId=<id>&path=<repo-relative>&staged=0|1` — `{ path,
staged, diff, truncated }`, capped at 200 000 characters.

Every git call uses an argument array (no shell), a 4 s timeout, and a 256 KiB
buffer cap. Nothing is watched and nothing is cached.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: the read-only JSON route over the `git` executable |
| `client.js` | Client half: the `conversation.input.dock` row, the branch popover, and the Sidebar tab body |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `git-bar` row |
| `locale/*.json` | Display metadata for Plugin Manager / Settings |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |
| `docs/PUBLISH.zh.md` | How to distribute the plugin (Git / npm / a market index) |
| `docs/market-index.example.json` | Format-1 market index template |
| `scripts/validate-index.mjs` | Rejects an index the way DSH's reader would |

plugins.description: 任务提示音：DSH 需要确认或一轮结束时播放 Windows 提示音，音效可在设置页挑选并试听
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify — 任务提示音

DSH 需要你、或者一轮活干完的时候，用 **Windows 自己的声音**提醒你一声。
声音由 DSH 的本机进程播放，所以页面在后台、你切到了别的窗口、甚至标签被静音，都还听得见。
音效在**设置 → 任务提示音**里挑，点一下就能试听。

## 它什么时候响

| 时机 | 事件 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|
| 有东西等你点确认（工具授权、权限提升…） | `approval/request` | 「需要你确认时」选的那个 |
| 智能体问了你一个问题 / 等你审计划 | `user-questions/request` | 同上 |
| 主会话一轮跑完 | `agent/status` 由 `running` 变 `idle` | 「任务完成时」选的那个 |

**不会响的情况**：

- 子代理、Agent Teams 成员的会话结束（设置页里可以打开，默认关）；
- 会话只是被创建、或本来就没在跑时收到 `idle` —— 只有「先 running 再 idle」才算一轮结束；
- 两声之间小于「最小间隔」（默认 1200 毫秒）；
- 刚响过「需要确认」后的「静默窗口」内（默认 5000 毫秒），那是同一次卡住，不是两次事件；
- 总开关关掉时。

## 设置页

**设置 → 任务提示音**（在「模型」和「插件」之间）。

- 两块音效，各有一份 Windows 自带音效列表（实时读 `C:\Windows\Media\*.wav`，你机器上现在 63 个）。
  **点名字＝选中并试听，点 ▶＝只试听**。
- 「自定义 wav」一行：填绝对路径（比如 `D:\Sounds\ping.wav`），▶ 试听，`使用` 选中。
  文件不存在会直接告诉你是哪个路径找不到。
- 进阶：子代理是否也响、最小间隔、静默窗口。

配置存在 `C:\Users\Acer\.dsh\storages\dsh-notify.json`，可以直接手改，插件会在 0.5 秒内读到新值。

## 那两声到底是谁在放

一次性的隐藏 `powershell.exe`，脚本用 `-EncodedCommand`（Base64 UTF-16LE）传：
路径里有空格、引号、中文都不会被 shell 重新解释，`windowsHide` 保证不闪黑窗。
找不到 `.wav` 时退回 `[System.Media.SystemSounds]`，跟随你的 Windows 声音方案。

实测：事件发生到出声约 **0.7 秒**（PowerShell 启动开销）。

一个副作用值得知道：**音量合成器里这一项显示为 "Windows PowerShell"**，不是 DSH。
如果你哪天单独静音了某个应用，注意别把它也静了。

## 装 / 卸 / 改

- 安装：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 指向本目录（首次）或包名 `dsh-notify`（已装过时）。
- 停用：设置 → 插件 里关掉这一行，或 `remove_bundle`。

### 改完必须「完全退出进程」，不是关窗口、也不是刷新页面

这一条值得单独写，因为它白白吃掉了三轮调试：

| 你做的动作 | 浏览器半边 | Host 半边 |
|---|---|---|
| 按 F5 / 重开窗口 | ✅ 会更新 | ❌ 还是旧的 |
| 插件里「禁用 → 启用」 | ✅ | ❌ **还是旧的**（Loader 复用启动时 import 的那一代模块，实测确认） |
| 完全退出 DSH 进程后重开 | ✅ | ✅ |

所以改完 `index.js`（或任何 Host 代码）之后，请**托盘图标右键 → 退出**，确认没有残留进程再打开：

```powershell
Get-Process 'DeepSeek Harness' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

验证方法：看 `storages\dsh-notify.log` 有没有多出新的一行，比对比进程启动时间和源文件修改时间。
`install_bundle` 对已安装包的改动会明确回 `restart-required` —— 那就是"必须要真重启"的意思。

## 自检（不需要 DSH）

```powershell
node _diag\notify-host-test.mjs      # Host 半边：事件判定 / 节流 / 配置读写 / 试听接口（34 项）
node _diag\notify-client-test.mjs    # 浏览器半边：注册 / 三个渲染分支（23 项）
node _diag\notify-sound-test.mjs     # 直接听某个音效，例如 chimes.wav
```

Host 测试用临时 `DSH_HOME` 和一个静音 wav，所以不会动你的真配置、也不会出声。

## 踩过的坑：一个"注册不上但没人告诉你"的通道

第一版设置页能显示，但一读配置就报 `transport failure for /notify/get: HTTP 405`。
我最初把通道注册写成了这样：

```js
ctx.inject(['connection'], (c) => c.connection.rpc.handle('/notify', handler))   // ✗
```

第一次尝试的修法是补上 `webServer` 注入 —— **没用**，而且暴露了真正的原因。
幸好当时加了一行诊断日志，它把异常原文写了下来：

```
channel /notify registration failed: Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (…dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:656:35)
    at Object.handle (…/lib/index.js:576:39)
```

`rpc.handle()` 里是 `owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), …)`，而 `owner` 来自
`get rpc() { const owner = this.ctx; … }` —— **`this.ctx` 是这个 service 自己的上下文**（connection 插件那个），
不是"读它的插件"。那个插件的 inject 列表是 `['credentials']`，没有 `webServer`，所以这行**必然抛错**。
换句话说：**在这个版本里 `rpc.handle()` 对插件是不可用的**（DSH 自己也从不调用它，只用不碰 `webServer` 的
`rpc.intercept('/api', …)`；而 `/api` 的拦截器已被 typertGateway 独占，`registerInterceptor` 明确禁止重复注册）。

失败之所以无声，是因为 Cordis 只丢掉抛错的子 fiber，**插件行仍然是 `active`**，页面那一侧只看到一个 405。

**最终用的是插件真能用的那个扩展点** —— `connection.fetch.register()`，它只往 Connection 的精确路由表里加一条，
全程不碰 `owner` 的任何 service：

```js
ctx.inject(['connection'], (c) => c.connection.fetch.register({
  path: '/api/notify.config',          // 必须在 /api 下
  methods: ['POST'],
  requestBody: 'buffered',
  fetch: async (request) => Response.json(await handleEndpoint(…)),
}))
```

路径**必须落在 `/api` 下**：Connection 自己为 `/api` 注册了 prefix 路由，那里做 Host/Origin 校验和
浏览器 Cookie 认证，然后把请求交给 `createSharedFetchHandler('/api')` —— 先查精确路由表，再查拦截器。
所以页面里一句普通的同源 `fetch('/api/notify.config')` 就自带认证，和整个 UI 走的是同一条路
（认证是签名 Cookie，`isAuthenticated()` 读 `cookie` 头，客户端默认就是 `globalThis.fetch`，不额外加头）。

教训：**这类失败不留任何痕迹**，所以 Host 半边每次启动都会往
`C:\Users\Acer\.dsh\storages\dsh-notify.log` 写一行"注册成功/失败 + 堆栈"，设置页遇到 404/405 也会直接点名这个文件。
回归测试里有三项盯着它：路由路径必须在 `/api` 下、声明必须是 POST+buffered、源码里**不得出现 `rpc.handle(`**。

## 实现要点

- `approval/request` 与 `user-questions/request` 是 waterfall 事件：本插件只观察，`next()` 在 try/catch
  **之外**调用且只调用一次 —— 提示音坏掉、甚至事件载荷一读就抛错，也不会让授权流程卡住（测试里专门有这一项）。
- 设置页数据走 `connection.fetch.register()` 的 `/api/notify.config`，浏览器半边用同源 `fetch`
  （不再需要 `connection` 客户端 service，所以 `inject` 只有 `slots` 和 `locale`）。
- 浏览器半边只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，不 import 任何 DSH 客户端包，不碰 app root，不往 `document.body` 追加东西。

plugins.description: DSH OpenViking 自动启动与恢复插件：会话前确保本机记忆服务可用。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-openviking-autostart

DSH 宿主平面 Cordis 插件（profile bundle）：**新会话开始前先确认 OpenViking 服务在运行，没运行就先拉起，再执行任务。**

## 它解决什么

本机把 OpenViking 当作 DSH 的长期记忆服务。手工启动 DSH Web 时，如果忘了开 OpenViking，整个会话都在"记忆离线"状态下进行：召回为空、写入进离线队列——等发现时已经过去很久。

这个插件把这件事变成机制，而不是每次靠人记得：
